annotations.title: Is there still time to respond to a rule on this?

description: Use when the user asks whether a U.S. federal rule on a topic is open for comment, when the deadline is, or when a final rule takes effect. Returns, as of today, the Federal Register documents mentioning the phrase whose comment period is still open (with days left) and the final rules still waiting to take effect, optionally for one agency, each linked. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: as of today: open comment periods and dates ahead; segment: agency. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For the long-run trend in rule-making, use run_regulatory_trend. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/regulatory-clock.json
